034/**
035 * Session object that lives for the duration of a single use of {@link CborParser}.
036 *
037 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
038 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
039 * </ul>
040 *
041 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
042 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/Cbor">CBOR Basics</a>
043 * </ul>
044 */
045@SuppressWarnings({
046   "rawtypes", // Raw types necessary for generic type handling
047   "unchecked", // Type erasure requires unchecked casts
048   "java:S115", // Constants use UPPER_snakeCase naming convention
049   "resource"  // Closeable resources are owned by the caller's parser session; Eclipse JDT @Owning warning is by design.
050})
051public class CborParserSession extends InputStreamParserSession implements TokenReadable, ArrayRecordReadable {
052
053   // Argument name constants for assertArgNotNull
054   private static final String ARG_ctx = "ctx";
055
056   /**
057    * Builder class.
058    */
059   public static class Builder extends InputStreamParserSession.Builder<Builder> {
060
061      final boolean nativeMode;
062      final int maxLength;
063
064      /**
065       * Constructor
066       *
067       * @param ctx The context creating this session.
068       *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
069       */
070      protected Builder(CborParser ctx) {
071         super(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
072         this.nativeMode = ctx.isNativeMode();
073         this.maxLength = ctx.getMaxLength();
074      }
075
076      @Override
077      public CborParserSession build() {
078         return new CborParserSession(this);
079      }
080
081   }
082
083   /**
084    * Creates a new builder for this object.
085    *
086    * @param ctx The context creating this session.
087    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
088    * @return A new builder.
089    */
090   public static Builder create(CborParser ctx) {
091      return new Builder(assertArgNotNull(ARG_ctx, ctx));
092   }
093
094   private final boolean nativeMode;
095   private final int maxLength;
096
097   /**
098    * Constructor.
099    *
100    * @param builder The builder for this object.
101    */
102   protected CborParserSession(Builder builder) {
103      super(builder);
104      this.nativeMode = builder.nativeMode;
105      this.maxLength = builder.maxLength;
106   }
107
108   /**
109    * Opens a low-level pull-parser cursor over a CBOR document, bound to this live session.
110    *
111    * <p>
112    * CBOR is already a token-shaped wire format (RFC 8949), so this cursor maps almost directly
113    * onto {@link CborInputStream#readDataType()}.  Indefinite-length containers
114    * (<c>0x9F</c> / <c>0xBF</c>) are handled by tracking a sentinel element-count of -1 on the
115    * container stack and emitting END_* on encountering the BREAK byte.
116    *
117    * <h5 class='section'>Builder properties honored:</h5>
118    * <c>autoCloseStreams</c>, <c>unbuffered</c>.
119    *
120    * <h5 class='section'>Builder properties NOT honored:</h5>
121    * <c>listener</c>, <c>debugOutputLines</c>, <c>consumes</c>, swaps, {@code @Schema}.
122    *
123    * @param input The input.
124    * @return A new {@link CborTokenReader}.
125    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying input.
126    */
127   @SuppressWarnings({
128      "java:S2095" // ParserPipe lifecycle is transferred to the returned CborTokenReader, which closes it via its own close(); the caller owns the cursor via try-with-resources.
129   })
130   @Override /* TokenReadable */
131   public TokenReader readTokens(Object input) throws IOException {
132      var pipe = new ParserPipe(input, isDebug(), isAutoCloseStreams(), isUnbuffered(), null);
133      return new CborTokenReader(pipe, this).setNativeMode(nativeMode).setMaxLength(maxLength);
134   }
135
136   /**
137    * Streaming array-element {@link RecordReader} backed by {@link CborTokenReader}.
138    * Memory is O(1) in the array length &mdash; CBOR's indefinite-length array support
139    * (0x9F .. 0xFF) makes the wrapper trivial.
140    *
141    * @param input The input.
142    * @return A new element-streamed {@link RecordReader}.
143    * @throws IOException If a problem occurred opening the underlying input.
144    */
145   @Override /* ArrayRecordReadable */
146   public RecordReader readArrayRecords(Object input) throws IOException {
147      try {
148         return StreamingArrayRecord.reader(readTokens(input));
149      } catch (ParseException e) {
150         throw new IOException(e);
151      }
152   }
153
154   /*
155    * Workhorse method.
156    */
157   @SuppressWarnings({
158      "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity acceptable for this specific logic
159      "java:S6541"  // Single-threaded session contexts do not require synchronization
160   })
161   <T> T readAnything(ClassMeta<?> eType, CborInputStream is, Object outer, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
162
163      if (eType == null)
164         eType = object();
165      var swap = (ObjectSwap<T,Object>)eType.getSwap(this);
166      var builder = (BuilderSwap<T,Object>)eType.getBuilderSwap(this);
167      ClassMeta<?> sType = null;
168      if (nn(builder))
169         sType = builder.getBuilderClassMeta(this);
170      else if (nn(swap))
171         sType = swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
172      else
173         sType = eType;
174
175      if (sType.isOptional())
176         return (T)o(readAnything(eType.getElementType(), is, outer, pMeta));
177
178      setCurrentClass(sType);
179
180      Object o = null;
181      DataType dt = is.readDataType();
182      var indefinite = is.isIndefinite();
183      long len = indefinite ? -1 : is.readLength();
184
185      // Handle CBOR semantic tags: skip tag, parse following data item
186      while (dt == TAG) {
187         dt = is.readDataType();
188         indefinite = is.isIndefinite();
189         len = indefinite ? -1 : is.readLength();
190      }
191
192      // Bound a definite array/map element count up front.  This is the databind path (elements
193      // accumulate into a collection below); the O(1)-memory streaming cursor is intentionally exempt so
194      // it can still emit tokens for large definite-length containers.  A definite container whose
195      // declared count is negative (e.g. an 8-byte 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF argument) is rejected here too.
196      if ((dt == ARRAY || dt == MAP) && !indefinite)
197         is.checkLength(len, dt == ARRAY ? "array" : "map");
198
199      if (dt != NULL) {
200         if (dt == BOOLEAN)
201            o = is.readBoolean();
202         else if (dt == UINT || dt == NINT) {
203            // Surface unsigned 64-bit by the target Java type (175fc GAP-1, aligned with the
204            // proto-binary R5 decision): a BigInteger field carries the full magnitude (values
205            // beyond signed long widen losslessly); any other type keeps the raw 64-bit bits as
206            // a long (preserving the native int64 round-trip used by epoch/millis temporal and
207            // duration values).
208            o = sType.inner() == BigInteger.class ? is.readBigInteger() : (Object)is.readLong();
209         }
210         else if (dt == FLOAT) {
211            // Prefer double for conversion; single-precision if target is Float
212            if (sType.isFloat() && !sType.isDouble())
213               o = is.readFloat();
214            else
215               o = is.readDouble();
216         } else if (dt == STRING)
217            o = trim(is.readString());
218         else if (dt == BINARY)
219            o = is.readBinary();
220         else if (dt == ARRAY && sType.isObject()) {
221            var jl = newGenericList();
222            for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
223               jl.add(readAnything(object(), is, outer, pMeta));
224            o = jl;
225         } else if (dt == MAP && sType.isObject()) {
226            var jm = newGenericMap();
227            for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
228               jm.put((String)readAnything(string(), is, outer, pMeta), readAnything(object(), is, jm, pMeta));
229            o = cast(jm, pMeta, eType);
230         }
231
232         if (sType.isObject()) {
233            // Do nothing.
234         } else if (nn(builder) || sType.canCreateNewBean(outer)) {
235            if (dt == MAP) {
236               BeanMap m = builder == null ? newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()) : toBeanMap(builder.create(this, eType));
237               var pb = swapParentBean(m.getBean(false));
238               try {
239                  for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++) {
240                     String pName = readAnything(string(), is, m.getBean(false), null);
241                     var bpm = m.getPropertyMeta(pName);
242                     if (bpm == null) {
243                        if (pName.equals(getBeanTypePropertyName(eType)))
244                           readAnything(string(), is, null, null);
245                        else
246                           onUnknownProperty(pName, m, readAnything(string(), is, null, null));
247                     } else {
248                        var cm = (ClassMeta<?>) bpm.getBeanInfo();
249                        Object value = readAnything(cm, is, m.getBean(false), bpm);
250                        setName(cm, value, pName);
251                        try {
252                           bpm.set(m, pName, value);
253                        } catch (BeanRuntimeException e) {
254                           onBeanSetterException(pMeta, e);
255                           throw e;
256                        }
257                     }
258                  }
259               } finally {
260                  swapParentBean(pb);
261               }
262               o = builder == null ? m.getBean() : builder.build(this, m.getBean(), eType);
263            } else {
264               throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid data type %s encountered for parse type %s", dt, sType);
265            }
266         } else if (sType.isMap()) {
267            if (dt == MAP) {
268               Map m = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Map)sType.newInstance(outer) : newGenericMap(sType));
269               for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++) {
270                  Object key = readAnything(sType.getKeyType(), is, outer, pMeta);
271                  var vt = sType.getValueType();
272                  Object value = readAnything(vt, is, m, pMeta);
273                  setName(vt, value, key);
274                  m.put(key, value);
275               }
276               o = m;
277            } else {
278               throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid data type %s encountered for parse type %s", dt, sType);
279            }
280         } else if (sType.isBoolean() || sType.isCharSequence() || sType.isChar() || sType.isNumber() || sType.isByteArray()) {
281            // Merged scalar tier: one CBOR data type (BOOLEAN/UINT/NINT/FLOAT/STRING/BINARY) covers
282            // many scalar Java types — the read already happened above and convertToType narrows.
283            o = convertToType(o, sType);
284         } else if (sType.isDate()) {
285            o = readDate(String.valueOf(o), sType);
286         } else if (sType.isCalendar()) {
287            o = readCalendar(String.valueOf(o), sType);
288         } else if (sType.isTemporal()) {
289            o = readTemporal(String.valueOf(o), sType);
290         } else if (sType.isDuration()) {
291            o = readDuration(String.valueOf(o));
292         } else if (sType.isPeriod()) {
293            o = readPeriod(String.valueOf(o));
294         } else if (sType.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(outer) && dt == STRING) {
295            o = sType.newInstanceFromString(outer, o == null ? "" : o.toString());
296         } else if (sType.isCollection()) {
297            if (dt == MAP) {
298               var m = newGenericMap();
299               for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
300                  m.put((String)readAnything(string(), is, outer, pMeta), readAnything(object(), is, m, pMeta));
301               o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
302            } else if (dt == ARRAY) {
303               Collection l = (sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection)sType.newInstance() : newGenericList());
304               for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
305                  l.add(readAnything(sType.getElementType(), is, l, pMeta));
306               o = l;
307            } else {
308               throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid data type %s encountered for parse type %s", dt, sType);
309            }
310         } else if (sType.isArray() || sType.isArgs()) {
311            if (dt == MAP) {
312               var m = newGenericMap();
313               for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
314                  m.put((String)readAnything(string(), is, outer, pMeta), readAnything(object(), is, m, pMeta));
315               o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
316            } else if (dt == ARRAY) {
317               Collection l = (sType.isCollection() && sType.canCreateNewInstance(outer) ? (Collection)sType.newInstance() : newGenericList());
318               for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
319                  l.add(readAnything(sType.isArgs() ? sType.getArg(i) : sType.getElementType(), is, l, pMeta));
320               o = toArray(sType, l);
321            } else {
322               throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid data type %s encountered for parse type %s", dt, sType);
323            }
324         } else if (dt == MAP) {
325            var m = newGenericMap();
326            for (var i = 0; shouldContinueContainer(is, len, i); i++)
327               m.put((String)readAnything(string(), is, outer, pMeta), readAnything(object(), is, m, pMeta));
328            if (m.containsKey(getBeanTypePropertyName(eType)))
329               o = cast(m, pMeta, eType);
330            else if (nn(sType.getProxyInvocationHandler()))
331               o = newBeanMap(outer, sType.inner()).load(m).getBean();
332            else
333               throw new ParseException(this, "Class '%s' could not be instantiated.  Reason: '%s'", cn(sType), sType.getNotABeanReason());
334         } else if (dt == UNDEFINED || dt == SIMPLE) {
335            // Treat as null for unknown simple values
336            o = null;
337         } else {
338            throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid data type %s encountered for parse type %s", dt, sType);
339         }
340      }
341
342      if (nn(swap) && nn(o))
343         o = unswap(swap, o, eType);
344
345      if (nn(parentBean()))
346         setParent(eType, o, parentBean());
347
348      return (T)o;
349   }
350
351   @Override /* Overridden from ParserSession */
352   protected <T> T doRead(ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws IOException, ParseException, ExecutableException {
353      try (CborInputStream is = new CborInputStream(pipe)) {
354         is.setMaxLength(maxLength);
355         return readAnything(type, is, getOuter(), null);
356      }
357   }
358
359   /**
360    * Returns whether the next iteration of a CBOR container loop should run.
361    *
362    * <p>
363    * For definite-length containers (<c>len &gt;= 0</c>) returns <jk>true</jk> while
364    * <c>i &lt; len</c>.  For indefinite-length containers (<c>len == -1</c>) peeks for the BREAK
365    * marker and returns <jk>false</jk> when found (consuming the BREAK byte), <jk>true</jk>
366    * otherwise.  In the indefinite case the accumulated element count is bounded by the configured
367    * maximum so a never-terminating stream of elements cannot grow the collection without limit.
368    */
369   private static boolean shouldContinueContainer(CborInputStream is, long len, int i) throws IOException {
370      if (len == -1) {
371         is.checkLength(i, "container");
372         return !is.peekBreak();
373      }
374      return i < len;
375   }
376}
